# {{ config.title }}

> Personal site of {{ config.title }}. The logs below are build logs that AI coding agents wrote while they did the work; Simon directed the work but did not write them. Each log keeps its dead ends and corrections, and each has a plain Markdown copy. The posts are Simon's own writing, and each has a plain Markdown copy too.

Log text is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
About the logs: {{ get_url(path="@/logs/_index.md") }}
